python3 -c '
from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

img67 = np.array(Image.open("/work/observations/obs_0067.png"))
img68 = np.array(Image.open("/work/observations/obs_0068.png"))

# Pose 67: x = -0.7929, y = 0.7071
# Pose 68: x = -0.2929, y = 0.7071 (dx = +0.5m forward!)

# Sofa width in 67 and 68:
s67 = np.where((img67[350, :, 0] > 90) & (img67[350, :, 0] < 130) & (img67[350, :, 1] > 100) & (img67[350, :, 1] < 140))[0]
s68 = np.where((img68[350, :, 0] > 90) & (img68[350, :, 0] < 130) & (img68[350, :, 1] > 100) & (img68[350, :, 1] < 140))[0]

w67 = s67[-1] - s67[0]
w68 = s68[-1] - s68[0]
print(f"Sofa width in 67: {w67} (cols {s67[0]} to {s67[-1]})")
print(f"Sofa width in 68: {w68} (cols {s68[0]} to {s68[-1]})")

# Optical triangulation:
# d67 / (d67 - 0.5) = w68 / w67
# d67 * (1 - w67/w68) = 0.5
d67 = 0.5 / (1.0 - float(w67) / float(w68))
print(f"Triangulated distance d67 = {d67:.3f} m")
sofa_front_x = -0.7929 + d67
print(f"Sofa front X: {sofa_front_x:.3f}")
'
